desc: Check the consistency of a database or table
r: xapian-check - Check the consistency of a database or table

xapian-check - Check the consistency of a database or table

If a whole database is checked, then additional cross-checks between the tables are performed.

The btree(s) is/are always checked - control the output verbosity with:

F = attempt to fix a broken database (implemented for chert currently) t = short tree printing f = full tree printing b = show free blocks v = show stats about B-tree (default) + = same as tbv e.g. xapian-check /var/lib/xapian/data/default
xapian-check /var/lib/xapian/data/default/postlist fbv
